issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring says max_steps but code reads max_step
issues.detail: The docstring documents max_steps, val_interval, and deepspeed_config, but __init__ reads trainer_args['max_step']. This is a guaranteed KeyError on first launch and an untyped-dict contract drift. Pick one name, fix the other, and validate required keys at __init__ time instead of crashing mid-setup.

issues.description: Checkpoint discovery parses 'step_N' from directory names with no atomicity or validity guard
issues.detail: _load_checkpoint globs 'step_*' dirs and sorts by int(name.split('step_')[-1]). A stray directory or partially-written checkpoint from a crashed save crashes training or silently resumes from corrupt state. Write a 'latest' marker or index.json on successful save, and validate candidates before loading.

issues.description: run() loop has no progress invariant and val_interval is advertised but unused
issues.detail: The outer while loop in run() depends on train() advancing global_step by save_interval; an empty iterator spins forever re-saving the same checkpoint. val_interval is documented but never consulted — validation actually fires every save_interval. Boundary cases (global_step==max_step on resume, save_interval not dividing max_step) are also handled incorrectly.

issues.description: _all_reduce_stats has unclear ownership and unstated cross-rank precondition
issues.detail: The function mutates the caller's dict in place while callers also rebuild stats as float dicts — both pure and destructive at once. It also iterates `for key in stats` and issues a collective per key, which deadlocks if any rank has differing keys or order. Return a new dict, and state/enforce that stats keys are globally identical.

issues.description: valid_*_specifier mini-language is whitespace-split but contains colon-delimited paths
issues.detail: The format 'task:name:data_json[:factor]' is split on whitespace, so any space in a path produces bogus specs; train.py is inconsistent in handling it. Replace the stringly-typed mini-language with repeated --flag or comma-separated entries, parsed once at the CLI boundary into a small dataclass.

issues.description: Non-rank-0 ranks silenced to CRITICAL; get_global_grad_norm() may be None when logged
issues.detail: Setting log_level='CRITICAL' on non-zero ranks makes hangs and OOMs on rank N invisible at 2am — keep at least ERROR/WARNING or gate behind a flag. Separately, DeepSpeed's get_global_grad_norm() returns None on skipped/overflow steps; logging None to wandb errors or pollutes metrics — guard or default to nan.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on three P0 issues in the new DeepSpeed trainer: a docstring/code key mismatch (max_steps vs max_step) that will KeyError on first launch, a checkpoint discovery routine that parses directory names with no atomicity guard, and a run() loop whose progress invariant and val_interval semantics are broken. Two P1 issues — _all_reduce_stats having unclear ownership and unstated cross-rank preconditions, plus a whitespace-split specifier mini-language that breaks on path spaces — point at the same root cause: untyped dicts and stringly-typed APIs where small dataclasses belong. NEEDS-WORK before merge.
